# bash completion for jet (generated by `jet completions bash`)
_jet() {
local cur prev cmds flags
COMPREPLY=()
cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
cmds="run check test build dev devtools serve debug repl new fmt fix lint explain doctor env push trust bridge services image bind add remove fetch update toolchain init lock store config gc outdated search info logs clean publish yank keygen key schema semindex impact expand vendor audit sbom emit eval bench completions man lsp version upgrade help"
flags="--json --color --version --emit-rust --check --small --locked --annotated --force --message --before --spdx --cyclonedx --advisory-db --vendor-dir --sbom --verbose --online --fix --dry-run --try-anyway --restart --swap --watch --project --pure --freestanding --allow-impure --target --explain-partition --capabilities-json --update-snapshots --coverage --rust -u --release --profile --a11y --scope"
if [[ "$cur" == -* ]]; then
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$flags" -- "$cur") )
return 0
fi
if [[ $COMP_CWORD -eq 1 ]]; then
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$cmds" -- "$cur") )
return 0
fi
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -f -- "$cur") )
}
complete -F _jet jet
